reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the WTN85201GB as a condenser dryer, led with the right first step (condenser and door filters), explained how to clean them properly, used a sensible 20-minute heat test to rule out heater faults without recommending parts, and gave good maintenance advice; its only lapse was not saying to unplug before pulling the condenser.
